content: The Simplified Geneva Score Calculator is a tool designed to assess the pre-test probability of pulmonary embolism (PE) using a streamlined scoring system. This simplified scoring method assigns a uniform one-point value to each parameter, replacing the previously weighted scoring system. The primary goal of this modification was to minimize the potential for errors when the score is applied in clinical practice. Importantly, the adoption of the simplified Geneva score does not compromise its diagnostic utility when compared to the original Geneva scoring system. This calculator provides a practical and efficient way to estimate the likelihood of pulmonary embolism by applying the simplified Geneva criteria.
